description: This file is a PHP script for listing user profiles in the vtiger CRM system, involving database queries, data processing, and rendering of a Smarty template for the user interface.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty template object customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getStdOutput
methods.description: Processes the result set of profiles from the database and returns an array of profile information with permissions.
